sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2026
sources.text: Four robbers armed with knives boarded the ship underway and escaped with stolen ship's engine spares. Incident reported to VTIS. Upon arrival at the anchorage, under escort, the Singapore Coast Guard boarded the ship for investigation. All crew members reported safe.
